name: Allgäuer Hof
beschreibung: The entry Allgäuer Hof is listed in the Camping category for the Tirol tourism portal, but could not be confirmed as a Tyrolean business. The specified coordinates (47.6530, 10.5739) are located in the Ostallgäu near Seeg in Bavaria and therefore outside Tirol. The only website listed is a classified ads profile that is no longer accessible. Information on location, address, telephone, email, opening hours and facilities is missing. Anyone wishing to camp in Tirol will find numerous official campsites in the region, for example in the Zillertal, the Ötztal, on the Achensee or in the Außerfern near Reutte. The Tyrolean Camping Act regulates the permissibility of pitches, and many businesses are listed through the regional tourism associations. For a reliable classification, the details of the entry should be checked and corrected.
